subject.title: Menu bar usage indicator is stale and does not match the opened menu

question: Should CodexBar prioritize immediate visual agreement between a tracked merged menu and its status-item meter, or preserve deferred status-item redraws until menu tracking ends when that avoids AppKit instability?
rationale: Current history shows redraw deferral was intentional, while the report establishes a legitimate at-a-glance consistency concern; source review alone cannot choose the preferred user-experience tradeoff.

options.title: Prove and narrow the mismatch
options.body: Reproduce on current main and update only the affected metric/image path if it can redraw without rebuilding the tracked menu.

options.title: Keep deferred redraw semantics
options.body: Retain the current tracking-time deferral if the reproduction shows it is required for stable AppKit menu interaction, and document the expected refresh timing.

recommendation.title: Prove and narrow the mismatch
recommendation.body: Reproduce on current main and update only the affected metric/image path if it can redraw without rebuilding the tracked menu.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent status-item history shows repeated ownership of the intentional redraw and menu-refresh behavior.
